info.title: Civil aviation accidents by state, year and type of operation (NTSB), 2008 to 2026: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Civil aviation accidents by state, year and type of operation (NTSB), 2008 to 2026: Civil aviation accidents in the United States investigated by the National Transportation Safety Board, for the nation and for each state, DC, Puerto Rico and Guam in each year from 2008 to September 2026: accidents, fatal accidents, deaths, serious and minor injuries, and the accidents and deaths by type of operation of the first aircraft (general aviation, airlines, commuter and on-demand, agricultural, other). NTSB incidents, accidents abroad, narratives and probable causes are not included. Accidents offshore or with no state are counted in the national record only.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
